About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

  • Open-source contribution experience.

  • Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

title: Data Scientist (Contract)
description:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

We are accelerating. The product works, clients renew, the market is taking shape. Every day, shoppers talk to AI agents before they buy, and conversion has been at the heart of how we build the product from day one. We now want to go further and faster, with someone fully dedicated to understanding what turns a conversation into a purchase, and to proving it with data.

As our freelance Data Scientist, full-time, you will dig into everything we have and tell us what drives conversion, what to change in the product next, and how to prove it. You will build on the work already done, challenge it, and find the levers we have not seen yet. You will work directly with the founders and the product and engineering teams.

Understand what drives conversion

  • Explore every data source we have: natural-language conversations, behavioural events, conversion tracking, product and advertiser metadata

  • Turn raw conversations into usable signals (intents, categories, features) that you define and build

  • Link what our agents say (answers, recommendations, tone) to what users do next, and turn it into concrete improvements for the agent team

  • Find the next levers that move purchases, and size the impact of each one

Experiment

  • Turn your findings into prioritised hypotheses the product team can act on

  • Design the A/B tests that validate them, then read the results

  • The engineering team implements the variants: you do not write production code

Strengthen what we measure

  • Spot the remaining blind spots in what we measure and specify the events and properties we are missing, for the engineering team to implement

Profile

Must-have

  • 4+ years of hands-on data science or analytics, with analyses that changed a product or business decision.

  • Advanced SQL and Python for data

  • Strong statistics and experimentation: A/B test design, causal reasoning, and the judgment to separate real effects from noise, selection bias and measurement artifacts, and to know when the data is too thin to conclude

  • Autonomous: you find the right questions in an open problem

  • AI-forward: you use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, agents) daily

  • Fluent French and professional English

  • Available now, full-time

A plus

  • NLP on real text data: classification, clustering, LLM-based labelling

  • E-commerce or retail experience

  • Conversion, CRO or funnel analytics

  • BigQuery, PostHog

  • Adtech or performance-marketing measurement (attribution, ROAS)

  • Familiarity with ranking, recommendations or search relevance

  • Startup experience

No school requirement.

The mission

  • Freelance, full-time, starting ASAP

  • 1 month minimum, around 3 months expected

  • For the right person, the mission can turn into a permanent role

  • Our data stack: BigQuery, PostHog, Python

Why join us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

title: Data Reliability Engineer
description:
🏨 The company

Resilience Care is a leading medical remote monitoring player and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is simple: improve patient care.
We build remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, powered by ePRO collection and AI techniques. Our platform helps care teams detect side effects early for continuous and proactive care, while our patient app helps people track and manage symptoms with tailored resources.
Our solutions optimize care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies.
We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your role

In a nutshell: You join the Data Reliability Engineering (DRE) team to build, operate and secure the data platform that carries healthcare data from our production services to the people who use it — internal operational teams, clinical research users, and external partners receiving contractual data exports.

Your impact: Data arrives on time, complete, traceable and secure — and when it doesn't, we know before the users do. You turn one-off data requests and manual export procedures into automated, monitored, reproducible pipelines.

Your day-to-day:

  • Build and operate data pipelines : ingestion from application events & databases, transformation, export.

  • Build the tooling that handles those pipelines, hand in hand with SRE: infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm on Kubernetes), deployment, CI/CD, secrets management, database operations and incident response.

  • Watch over data quality and pipeline health: Grafana dashboards, alerting, and metric- and log-based observability, so failures are detected and diagnosed fast.

  • Own data contracts and data quality: agree with the emitting squads on schemas, semantics and breaking-change rules, and enforce them with automated tests (freshness, completeness, referential integrity) that fail loudly before the data reaches its users.

  • Deliver secure data exports to external partners and institutions.

  • Provision and maintain dedicated PostgreSQL Research Spaces for clinical study teams, including access control and data scoping per study.

  • Help the modelers scale their work: industrialize the dbt project so a single modelisation written by a Data Analyst is centralized, parallelized and applied across several targets.

  • Work directly with the requesters: scope the need, challenge it, agree on what is feasible, deliver, and document.

  • Work with the product squads on the data they emit: challenge their design upstream, and take part in the implementation on their side (TypeScript) when needed — you contribute to their code, they keep their roadmap.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design and continuous improvement of engineering standards.

✨ Your team

  • Your future teammates: Mélody Ballouard and Alric Gaurier — Data Reliability Engineers.

The team owns the data pipeline end to end: ingestion, transformation, exports, and the infrastructure underneath. You'll be exposed to all of it from day one.

  • Your manager: Alric Gaurier

  • Team's extra: A small team with direct exposure to clinical research, medical and operational stakeholders. What you build is used by named people you talk to every week — not by an anonymous backlog.

👤 What we are looking for

  • ⚙️ You are the right person if you can:

    • Ship production-grade Python (tests, typing, code quality, reviews, CI), and use AI tools as a multiplier without letting go of engineering ownership.

    • Build and operate data pipelines and orchestration (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster or equivalent), including event streams (Kafka) and object/file transports (S3, SFTP).

    • Write and optimize advanced SQL on PostgreSQL (indexing, query plans, incremental loads).

    • Push dbt well beyond basic usage: macros and Jinja, multi-target projects, incremental strategies, tests, packages and CI integration.

    • Deploy and operate what you build (Terraform, Helm/Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD), with meaningful monitoring and alerting (Grafana or equivalent) — and lead the diagnosis when something breaks.

    • Read and contribute to TypeScript codebases when the pipeline meets the application side, with a solid grasp of back-end API architecture (REST design, versioning, authentication, pagination, contracts).

  • 🙂 You are the right person if you have:

    • Strong communication skills — this is not a nice-to-have in this role. You will spend real time with non-technical requesters.

    • The ability to translate an operational or scientific need into a technical specification, and to say no (and explain why) when a request is not feasible or not compliant — with the support of the Legal/Compliance department.

    • Comfort collaborating with SRE on shared infrastructure, and with scientific profiles on clinical trial data.

    • Rigor with sensitive data: you treat patient data with the caution it deserves, by reflex.

    • Ownership, autonomy and accountability, including on-call-style responsibility for what you ship — with a structured, detail-oriented approach, a bias for automation, and a focus on impact and maintainability.

    • Curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset — the reflex to go beyond your own stack: reading a product squad's code, digging into an API or an infrastructure layer you don't own, and learning what you need to unblock yourself instead of waiting for someone else.

  • 📃 You are the right person if you have already:

    • ~4–6 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or backend with a strong infrastructure component.

    • Operated production pipelines you were accountable for (not just built them).

    • Written and reviewed infrastructure as code in a team setting.

    • Delivered data to stakeholders outside your own team, and handled the conversation that goes with it.

    • Worked in a maintained codebase (Git workflow, PRs, CI).

    • Operated in a context with high standards (security, compliance, sensitive data).

  • It's a plus if you:

    • Have exposure to healthcare data, GDPR-heavy or HDS-hosted environments.

    • Have supported scientific or clinical research users (study datasets, cohort extraction, data requests from investigators).

    • Have handled contractual data exchanges with external partners (data transfer agreements, delivery SLAs, encryption requirements).

💛 Why join us?

  • A mission that holds up: improving patient care with data.

  • Real ownership over a full platform — pipelines and the infrastructure they run on — not a narrow slice.

  • Direct contact with the people your work serves, including clinical research teams running active studies.

  • A culture focused on automation, observability and continuous improvement, with practical AI usage.

  • Remote-friendly setup and an environment that values quality, standards and ownership.

Hiring process

  1. Screening - Elena (15 min): validate motivation and role prerequisites

  2. Manager Fit - Alric (30 min): position fit, and an honest conversation about the ops-and-build nature of the role

  3. Technical Case Study - live session (1h30), no preparation: you work through a small realistic case with us — pipeline design, infrastructure and data export constraints. We look at how you reason and what you ask, not at a polished deliverable.

  4. Team fit : Fit interview Mellody, Anna, Guillaume (30 min): collaboration fit with Research/Clinical and operational requesters

description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as Senior Workforce Manager – Capacity Planning & BPO Strategy to own the global capacity planning framework across all of Qonto's Ops factories — Banking Operations, AML/Fraud, KYCB, and Customer Care & Success. You'll set the methodology every factory uses, hold the consolidated budget view, and be the senior owner of BPO relationships at a strategic and contractual level. This is a hands-on build-and-run role: you'll design the model and direct its rollout, under the guidance of Marie Piquemil, our Head of Operations Enablement.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Design and own the capacity planning framework: You'll build the reference model — volume drivers, FTE requirements, BPO productive-hours — and set the forecasting cadence, templates, and definitions every factory's WFM analyst works from.
  • Optimise the internal vs. BPO capacity mix: You'll build the system that determines the right balance of internal agents and BPO capacity to cover workload at the lowest sustainable cost and risk, across all factories.
  • Own the global BPO budget view: You'll hold the actuals-vs-plan picture for exec reporting, interface with Finance on planning and reconciliation, and surface cross-factory cost inefficiencies invisible at the local level.
  • Lead BPO relationships at a strategic level: You'll be the senior point of contact for BPO partners on capacity, contracts, and escalations — and define the invoice validation standard used across all factories.
  • Enable and align factory-level WFM analysts: You'll set the standards and operating cadence for factory analysts through dotted-line governance, and run the monthly cross-factory alignment ritual covering forecast review, capacity risk, and invoice anomalies.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • WFM leadership with BPO depth: You've got 5+ years in Workforce Management, with hands-on exposure to both BPO-managed and internal-agent capacity models.
  • Methodology builder, not just operator: You've designed or significantly overhauled a capacity planning framework — you know what it takes to build one from scratch, not just run what's already there.
  • BPO vendor ownership: You've managed outsourcing relationships at a contractual and strategic level — SLAs, invoicing, escalations — and held partners accountable to real standards.
  • Influence-based leader: You're effective without direct authority — you set standards, coach local relays, and drive adoption across semi-autonomous teams who don't report to you.
  • AI-curious: You look for ways to use AI to work faster and smarter, and you're ready to keep adapting as the role evolves with it.
  • French and English fluency: You have a strong command of both French and English. 

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A founding mandate in a brand-new, centralized operations function — you'll help shape how it works from day one.
  • Direct line of sight into Qonto's banking license transition, raising the bar on operational rigor as the company scales.
  • Real autonomy over a strategic mission with executive visibility into the outcome.
  • A seat at the table as a genuine business partner to Finance and factory leadership, not just an operator.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Marie Piquemil, our Head of Operations Enablement.

  • Her path? Marie spent five years as COO at Morning, then built and led an international CX operations team at Swile (7 people across France and Brazil, five post-merger integrations). Most recently as VP Operations at Combo, she ran RevOps, Enablement, and Data teams, drove a post-merger integration, and launched a new Payroll Business Unit from scratch. She's been an operator, a builder, and a manager of managers.
  • What does she bring to the team? Marie has built exactly the kind of cross-functional operations infrastructure this role will strengthen. She'll give you the strategic context and the autonomy to own your projects — while staying close on the decisions that matter.
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

title: Director, Business Development
description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

title: Gestionnaire des dossiers administratifs des élèves
employer: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description:
Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Au sein de la Direction de la formation, le pôle « admissions, scolarité, stages », assure le cadre administratif de gestion des élèves dans leurs parcours de formation. Il agit en fonction support des directeurs de programme.

 

Le/la titulaire du poste est affecté(e) au sein de la Direction de la Formation, sur le site de Brest, et est rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement à la Directrice du pôle « admissions, scolarité, stages ».

Dans ce cadre, l’ENSTA recrute, pour son campus de Brest, un/une gestionnaire administratif qui assurera le suivi des dossiers élèves, en particulier des élèves militaires sous statut d’IETA (Ingénieur des études et techniques de l’armement)

 

Missions / Activités principales :

 

Le titulaire du poste est chargé(e) du suivi administratif des élèves civils :

  • Elaboration et la diffusion des certificats de scolarité et autres documents de scolarité (certificat d'inscription ...)

  • Suivi d’attestation CVEC

  • Suivi des bourses étudiantes, en lien avec le CROUS, en qualité de correspondant(e) bourses.

  • Gestion des cartes étudiantes,

  • Gestion des demandes de financements par la formation continue,

  • Gestion des déplacements et répartition des étudiants pour les actions de promotion de l’offre de formation,

  • Participation aux activités du pôle

 

Sous l'autorité fonctionnelle du Directeur des études IETA et de l'Adjointe Officiers des corps de l'armement, le/la titulaire du poste assure la gestion administrative des élèves sous statut IETA (Ingénieur des études et techniques de l’armement) :

 

  • Assurer la gestion administrative et le suivi individuel des élèves militaires : dossiers, solde, cartes militaires, suivi médical, permissions, affectations, arrêts de travail, accidents, décorations, etc ;

  • Assurer la liaison avec le service médical de la base navale de Brest ;

  • Assurer la gestion et le suivi des habilitations des étudiants civils et des personnels du campus de Brest ;

  • Veiller au respect des procédures, à la confidentialité et à la tenue à jour des dossiers.

 

Activités annexes :

  • Elaborer des tableaux de bords pour les enquêtes, statistiques et bilans

  • Actualisation des dossiers élèves dans le SI de scolarité.

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole.

 

Niveau de diplôme et formations :

Bac à Bac+2 en gestion administrative, gestion des ressources humaines ou dans un domaine équivalent, avec une expérience professionnelle similaire. Une expérience dans des environnements liés à l'enseignement supérieur et/au ministère des armées serait un plus.

 

 Emploi :

Poste ouvert aux candidats :

  • Fonctionnaire de catégorie C - RIFSEEP 1

  • Agent contractuel de catégorie C (emploi pérenne ; CDD de 1 à 3 ans renouvelable) CDI possible après 2 ans de CDD

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation « SECRET »

 

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : 3 à 5 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : 1er novembre 2026

Rémunération :

  • Fonctionnaires : selon les conditions statutaires (grille indiciaire, IFSE, CIA)

  • Contractuels : en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle sur des postes de niveau équivalent

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus de Brest,

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après période d’essai et après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 

 Présentation de l’Ecole :

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.


Profil attendu :

 

Connaissances :

  • Règles et méthodes de gestion administrative

  • Expression écrite et orale en français et anglais

  • Organisation et fonctionnement de l’enseignement supérieur

  • Organisation et fonctionnement de la DGA

 

 

Savoir-faire :

  • Savoir appliquer les dispositions réglementaires

  • Être à l’aise avec les systèmes d’information

  • Être à l’aise avec les logiciels de bureautique

  • Savoir analyser et synthétiser des informations

  • Utiliser les techniques de rédaction administrative

  • Savoir appliquer les règles, protocoles et procédures

  • Savoir planifier son temps et s’organiser de manière méthodique

 

Savoir-être :

  • Discrétion professionnelle

  • Sens des relations humaines

  • Curiosité

  • Autonomie

  • Travail en équipe

  • Rigueur et organisation

Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Notre objectif est clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Dans le cadre du lancement et du déploiement de nos pompes à chaleur en France, nous recherchons notre premier·ère Superviseur·ise CVC/HVAC pour superviser les installations de nos pompes à chaleur air-air. Nous recherchons une personne passionnée, ayant de l’expérience dans l’installation de pompes à chaleur et/ou systèmes de chauffage et désireuse de nous aider à développer cette activité en France.

Il s’agit d’un poste sur le terrain couvrant la région d’Amiens, mais tu seras également amené·e à travailler depuis ton domicile ou depuis notre bureau de Lille lorsque cela sera nécessaire.


Ce que tu feras

Profil recherché
- Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans l’installation et la maintenance de systèmes de pompes à chaleur aérothermiques
- Tu es disponible et prêt·e à te déplacer dans la région d’Amiens et le Nord de la France
- Tu es un·e technicien·ne expérimenté·e, notamment en plomberie et chauffage, et tu possèdes des connaissances en conception de systèmes de chauffage ; tu es en mesure de dépanner toi-même et d’intervenir techniquement sur place sur les chantiers
- Tu sais examiner et être force de proposition sur des cahiers des charges techniques ainsi que des plans mécaniques
- Tu as l'esprit entrepreneur : tu rejoins un nouveau projet où "tout est à faire". Tu n’as pas peur de partir d'une feuille blanche, tester, apprendre et avancer en autonomie.

- Tu as le goût du challenge, tu aimes aller sur le terrain ; tu n'as pas peur de te confronter aux artisans et de les aider à surmonter les irritants rencontrés. Doté·e d'un fort capital sympathie, tu sais fédérer tes interlocuteurs et les faire devenir de véritables ambassadeurs d’Octopus Energy !



Pré-requis & Qualifications

- Permis voiture en cours de validité
- Diplôme(s) de niveau CAP/BEP, ou VAE de niveau équivalent
- Avoir travaillé précédemment dans des entreprises certifiées RGE & Qualibat 
- Maîtrise de l’anglais technique à l’écrit & l’oral (niveau B1-B2) 
- Habilitation électrique (BR NF C18-510)

Ce sera également un plus si :
- Tu es à l’aise avec les outils & le numérique, notamment Excel
- Tu as de l’expérience avec la partie “électrique” des pompes à chaleur 
- Tu possèdes l’habilitation électrique BR

Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ?

Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.

description:

You’ll serve as the senior commercial and strategic point of contact for executive stakeholders, helping clients turn customer data into measurable revenue growth. The role combines consulting, account leadership, commercial ownership, and project direction without requiring you to be the hands-on technical builder. You’ll work closely with architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scoped, delivered, and aligned with business objectives. With clients across Europe and North America, you’ll operate in a diverse environment spanning multiple industries, technologies, and regulatory contexts. This is a high-ownership opportunity for an experienced client leader who can connect strategy, technology, and commercial outcomes.


Accountabilities
  • Own the executive-level relationship across a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary strategic contact for senior marketing and growth stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain a strong client cadence through biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews covering results, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.
  • Keep clients proactively informed about progress, budgets, timelines, risks, and decisions, ensuring there are no unexpected developments.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting each challenge to the relevant customer pain, metric, business impact, and potential solution.
  • Build and defend growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients, using measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle strategies, experimentation roadmaps, and performance readouts.
  • Translate technical decisions and recommendations into clear business implications that executive stakeholders can understand and act upon.
  • Scope projects and translate client requirements into sufficiently detailed briefs for architects and engineers, while remaining accountable for the quality and business relevance of the final outcome.
  • Lead project execution through sprint cadence, board management, dependencies, risks, timelines, and critical-path oversight rather than performing the technical implementation yourself.
  • Review completed work against agreed client objectives before delivery and ensure commitments are fulfilled to the expected standard.
  • Run pre-sales discovery, qualify opportunities, develop proposals, and present scope, phasing, investment, and business cases directly to prospective clients.
  • Partner with Sales throughout qualification, discovery, and closing before taking ownership of the account during delivery.
  • Price and scope technical work with profitability and delivery feasibility in mind.

  • Maintain a six-month forward roadmap so future engagements can be planned and contracted before existing scopes come to an end.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 5 years owning senior client relationships with direct revenue responsibility.
    • Fully fluent English, combined with professional working proficiency in at least one additional European language such as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
    • Strong understanding of the full marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost between stages.
    • Solid understanding of how marketing technology supports modern marketing operations, including advertising, customer data platforms, marketing engagement, CRM, analytics, and related infrastructure.
    • Advisory-level knowledge of modern marketing and customer data technologies, with the ability to assess technology choices, understand trade-offs, evaluate how systems work together, and challenge poor technical recommendations without being responsible for configuration or coding.
    • Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and data-driven approaches for improving marketing performance and returns.
    • Demonstrated success retaining and expanding client accounts, ideally supported by measurable commercial results.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, qualification, scoping, proposal development, and presenting solutions to executive buyers.
    • Experience scoping and pricing technical work in a way that balances client value, delivery feasibility, and profitability.
    • Understanding of how European businesses purchase, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent requirements.
    • Advisory command of customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, or RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4; lifecycle tools such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, or Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt; tag management; CRM; and consent management platforms.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive issues through to resolution.
    • Excellent strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to balance client value, delivery quality, account health, and profitability.
    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, particularly with senior and executive stakeholders.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities in an environment where consulting, delivery, and business development can compete for attention.
    • Experience working with clients across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working across both European and North American client portfolios is a plus.
    • Experience building or helping establish a regional practice is a plus.

title: Agentic Compiler Engineer
description:
ABOUT KOG

Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels.

On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming.

On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs.

Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled.

Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference.

The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs.

Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog.

 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

You will work directly on AGCO.

The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization.

You will contribute to areas such as:

  • Compiler and IR design for representing and transforming LLM computations.

  • Optimization passes, lowering, and code generation.

  • Search methods for exploring different implementations and execution strategies.

  • Verification and correctness checks for generated changes.

  • GPU execution, profiling, and performance optimization.

  • LLM inference across operators, memory, parallelism, and communication.

  • Optimization loops that connect generated changes to measurements on real GPUs.

One direction we are exploring combines an IR, a verifier, a compiler, and a search optimizer. We plan to start with focused problems, build working prototypes, and extend the system from what we learn.

Your main area will depend on your experience, skills, and interests. You may focus more on compilers, GPU systems, or LLM inference while working closely with people across the full stack.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We look for engineers with deep technical expertise and original work in at least one area relevant to AGCO.

Relevant experience includes:

  • Compiler engineering, including optimization passes, IRs, lowering, code generation, LLVM, or MLIR.

  • GPU programming with CUDA, HIP, Metal, Vulkan, or similar technologies.

  • GPU performance work involving kernels, memory, synchronization, profiling, or hardware behavior.

  • LLM inference engines and performance optimization.

  • Attention, MoE, parallelism, communication, or other systems-level parts of LLM execution.

  • Formal verification, equivalence checking, SAT/SMT, or related methods.

  • Systems that generate, search, test, benchmark, or optimize code automatically.

We care about what you personally built and the technical decisions behind it. Strong candidates can explain the problem, their approach, the alternatives they explored, and how they measured the result.

We review technical work during the process. This can be public code, an upstream contribution, a paper, a thesis, a technical project, or a detailed write-up based on work you can share.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

You will join a small team building AGCO as a core part of Kog's technology.

  • Work at the intersection of compilers, GPU systems, and LLM inference.

  • Direct access to engineers working across the full inference stack.

  • A fast loop from an optimization idea to compilation, execution, verification, and measurement on real GPUs.

  • The opportunity to go deep in your strongest technical area while expanding into the other parts of the stack.

  • High ownership over technical decisions and systems that will shape how Kog optimizes LLM inference.

This role is based in Paris, and we are looking for candidates who can relocate to Paris and work closely with the team.

Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Conseiller de vente en stage pour rejoindre notre équipe retail à Marseille dès le mois de septembre 2026. Ce poste est basé à Marseille (13).

Rattaché(e) au Responsable de l'Appartement, vos principales responsabilités seront :

Délivrer une expérience client singulière :

  • Faire du client la priorité de l’appartement pour garantir un service client optimal ;
  • Incarner l’esprit et le style Sezane par une présentation impeccable (respect du grooming) ;
  • Accueillir vos clients avec générosité et empathie afin de leur offrir la meilleure expérience possible ;
  • Considérer la personnalité de vos Clients afin d'identifier ses désirs ;
  • Faire découvrir la Marque et nos différents univers/ produits ;
  • Etre ambassadeur de l'omnicanalité de la Marque (appartement et web) ;
  • Faire preuve de curiosité et développer une connaissance approfondie de la Marque et des produits ;
  • Être force de proposition d’actions spécifiques pour rendre l’expérience client mémorable et unique ;
  • Traiter les réclamations et insatisfactions clients pour satisfaire et fidéliser nos clients ;
  • Connaître notre politique RSE pour répondre aux clients.

Garantir l’image de Marque :

  • Connaître les règles de bases du merchandising Sézane ;
  • Vérifier l’étiquetage des produits sur le floor ;
  • Participer à l’implantation du merchandising et veiller à son suivi ;
  • Offrir aux clients une expérience shopping passionnante et inspirante ;
  • Suivre et maintenir le niveau commercial du point de vente ;
  • Avoir une culture mode pour être force de propositions.

Avoir un esprit d’équipe :

  • Etre Team-player, participer à toutes les tâches annexes ;
  • Participer à la création d’un environnement positif et harmonieux pour créer une synergie de groupe ;
  • Relayer les engagements de la marque.

Requirements

  • Vous avez une première expérience réussie en prêt à porter, en hôtellerie, en restauration, en vente, en animation… ou pas encore, mais êtes animé par le relationnel client?
  • Vous avez le sens du service, une excellente présentation et une forte sensibilité mode ;
  • Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe, l’envie de partager et développer vos compétences dans un environnement agile et galvanisant ;
  • Vous n’aimez pas vous ennuyer car vous débordez d’énergie?

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

Vous vous êtes reconnu(e) dans ce descriptif et souhaitez rejoindre l’aventure Sézane ?

Alors n’attendez plus !

title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

  • Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
  • 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries
  • 30 days paid vacation per year
  • Salary bands for a fair corporate culture
  • Monthly allowance of €50 for your BAV
  • Annual 360° feedback loops with clear promotion criteria and an individual career path
  • Responsibility from day one in a company that encourages personal responsibility and growth
  • Relocation costs can be reimbursed on a pro rata basis
  • Regular company events such as summer party, Christmas party
  • Paid team dinners or activities for each team twice a year
  • Free parking right outside the door
  • Perks and benefits: JobRad, subsidized lunch, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, free language courses and discounted memberships at several gyms and for the Wellpass
  • Fresh fruit, free drinks and snacks in the office

title: Responsable bourses et mobilité internationale F/H
description:
Vos missions

Vous assurez la gestion des dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale des étudiants et des personnels et contribuez au pilotage de celui-ci.

Vous garantissez la qualité, la conformité et le suivi administratif et financier des dispositifs de bourses, notamment dans le cadre du programme Erasmus+.

En complément de cette mission principale, vous contribuez à la mise en œuvre des engagements de l’UTC dans le cadre de la Charte Erasmus+ et de ses grandes priorités, inclusion et diversité, transition écologique, transformation numérique, participation à la vie démocratique et aux valeurs européennes.

Dans ce cadre, vous participez au développement d’actions à destination des étudiants et des personnels : événements, actions de sensibilisation, formations courtes, ressources et formations en ligne.

En tant que référent-e « Transition numérique » Erasmus+ de la DRI, vous accompagnez également la transformation numérique des processus de mobilité et participez activement au déploiement, au paramétrage fonctionnel et à l’appropriation du logiciel de gestion de la mobilité internationale et des partenariats universitaires au sein de la DRI.

Vos activités

1. Coordonner l’activité du pôle « Bourses »

  • Assurer la gestion des différents dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale des étudiants et des personnels

  • Coordonner la gestion des bourses Erasmus+ et des autres dispositifs de financement nationaux, régionaux ou institutionnels

  • Organiser et promouvoir les bourses de mobilités internationales (campagnes d’attribution des aides, information et accompagnement des étudiants et personnels)

  • Assurer le suivi administratif et financier des dossiers de bourses de mobilité internationale et budgets dédiés

  • Produire les données, indicateurs, bilans et statistiques

  • Garantir le respect des critères d’éligibilité, des procédures et des règles propres aux différents programmes

  • Participer à la définition et à l’évolution des critères et procédures, dans une logique de simplification, de fiabilisation et d’amélioration continue.

  • Contribuer aux rapports Erasmus+, aux bilans institutionnels ainsi qu’aux contrôles et audits éventuels

  • Assurer une veille sur l’évolution des dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale

2. Accompagner le déploiement de la solution numérique dédiée à la gestion de la mobilité internationale et la transformation numérique des processus

Dans le cadre du déploiement de cet outil à l’UTC, vous participez à la transformation et à la dématérialisation des processus de gestion de la mobilité internationale.

À ce titre, vous contribuez notamment au/à l’:

  • Déploiement de la solution numérique : analyse des processus existants, workflows, tests, paramétrage…

  • Amélioration régulière : cohérence, fiabilité des données, évolution

  • Accompagnement des membres du service : prise en main, tutoriels

  • Accompagnement des étudiants et personnels

  • Développement d’une utilisation experte progressive : indicateurs et suivi… 

Vous participez ainsi à faire de la solution numérique un outil d’amélioration et de transformation des processus. 

3. Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des priorités de la Charte Erasmus+

Contribuer à la déclinaison opérationnelle des engagements de l’UTC dans le cadre de la Charte Erasmus+ et de ses quatre grandes priorités :

  • Inclusion et diversité : favoriser l’accès à la mobilité des publics ayant moins d’opportunités et améliorer leur accompagnement.

  • Transition écologique : promouvoir une mobilité internationale plus responsable et sensibiliser aux enjeux environnementaux.

  • Transformation numérique : développer les usages et ressources numériques liés à la mobilité et accompagner la dématérialisation des dispositifs Erasmus+.

  • Participation et citoyenneté européenne : développer des actions favorisant la connaissance de l’Europe, de ses valeurs et des opportunités offertes par Erasmus+. 

4. Contribuer à la promotion des actions et événements à destination des étudiants

Contribuer à la promotion de la mobilité internationale et des priorités Erasmus+ :

  • événements étudiants (Erasmus Days, rencontres interculturelles, témoignages, challenges, etc.) ;

  • ateliers de préparation au départ et de valorisation du retour de mobilité ;

  • actions autour de l’Europe, de l’inclusion, de l’interculturalité et de la mobilité durable. 

5. Contribuer au développement des formations courtes et des ressources pédagogiques

Contribuer à la conception et à l’animation de formations courtes, ateliers et ressources pédagogiques, en présentiel, en ligne ou en format hybride, dans le contexte de la mission (tutoriels et ressources numériques destinés aux étudiants et personnels). 

6. Participer aux projets transversaux de la DRI

Participer, selon les besoins, aux projets transversaux de la Direction aux Relations Internationales : projets Erasmus+, alliance européenne SUNRISE, événements internationaux, actions de promotion de la mobilité, internationalisation des formations et démarches d’amélioration continue

Travailler en interaction avec les autres pôles de la DRI, les services et enseignants de l’UTC, les associations étudiantes et les partenaires institutionnels.

Informations complémentaires

Dates pour candidater

title: FPGA Engineer - Electronic Warfare
description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

  • Own the development of FPGA functions for our electronic warfare and signals intelligence capabilities, from initial architecture to validation on operational hardware.

  • Work with systems and algorithm engineers to define processing requirements and assess implementation feasibility.

  • Build RTL modules in VHDL or SystemVerilog to process digitized RF signals, extract relevant information, and generate waveforms.

  • Adapt and validate DSP algorithms for FPGA implementation, balancing numerical accuracy, processing speed, and hardware resources.

  • Integrate acquisition and processing chains, including digital down-conversion, filtering, channelization, FFT, detection, direction-finding, and classification.

  • Establish verification methods and testbenches to check functional behavior and performance throughout development.

  • Connect programmable logic to RF converters and embedded processors, defining data transfers, control interfaces, clocking, and synchronization.

  • Resolve implementation constraints, achieve timing closure, and optimize resource utilization and power consumption.

  • Bring up FPGA designs on target boards, investigate integration issues, and correlate measured behavior with simulation results.

  • Contribute to laboratory and field testing alongside RF, software, and systems engineers.

  • Maintain clear design records, interface specifications, and validation evidence.

  • Improve reusable FPGA components and development practices as the product portfolio grows.

Candidate Profile

  • MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related field.

  • Strong experience developing and verifying RTL in VHDL or SystemVerilog, with a focus on digital signal processing.

  • Practical experience implementing designs on SoC FPGAs, including synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and hardware debugging.

  • Strong understanding of sampled signals, frequency conversion, digital filtering, spectral analysis, and fixed-point numerical behavior.

  • Ability to reason across FPGA, processor, and RF hardware boundaries when making design decisions.

  • Experience modelling algorithms and comparing reference models with hardware results; familiarity with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, or HLS is a plus.

  • Familiarity with RF measurements and laboratory equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes, is a plus.

  • Prior experience in electronic warfare is welcome but not required.


Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on engineer who enjoys taking designs from simulation to working hardware.

  • Methodical approach to debugging, with the ability to isolate problems across complex signal chains.

  • Able to own a technical scope independently and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

  • Rigorous approach to verification, documentation, and design traceability.

  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and adapting to evolving product requirements.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company.

  • High integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive defense technologies.

Du begeisterst dich für Zahlen, legst Wert auf Präzision und möchtest aktiv das Wachstum von FELFEL mitgestalten? Als Financial Accountant (80–100%, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung) in Zürich Wiedikon übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem agilen Finance Team. Hier formst du nicht nur Zahlen, sondern gestaltest gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens.


DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

  • Führe das Tagesgeschäft inklusive Haupt- und Nebenbücher (Debitoren, Kreditoren, Bank- und Zahlungsabstimmungen) für unsere Schweizer Gesellschaft und unterstütze das Tagesgeschäft unserer US-Gesellschaft.
  • Erstelle Verrechnungen an Kunden und wirke bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen nach Schweizer Recht mit.
  • Pflege und optimiere unser ERP-System (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC), um dessen kontinuierliche Skalierbarkeit sicherzustellen.
  • Agiere als Ansprechperson für interne sowie externe Stakeholder bei Fragen zur Rechnungsstellung und Kreditorenbuchhaltung.
  • Wirke an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finanzprozesse mit.
  • Steuere die Kommunikation als Schnittstelle zu externen Partnern wie ERP-Support, Behörden und Lieferanten.
  • Unterstütze bei der Erstellung von MWST-Abrechnungen, Sales and Use Tax Meldungen für unsere US-Gesellschaft sowie bei der jährlichen Steuererklärung.


WAS DU MITBRINGST

  • 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen in einem ähnlichen Umfeld.
  • Abschluss als Eidg. Finanzfachmann/frau im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (oder aktuell in entsprechender Ausbildung).
  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC von Vorteil).
  • Leidenschaft für Zahlen, Strukturen und Prozesse in einem agilen Umfeld.
  • Selbstständige, exakte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
  • Ausgeprägter Teamgeist und Fähigkeit, mit internen sowie externen Partnern professionell zu kommunizieren.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Nichtraucher:in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riechst, weder bei der Arbeit noch bei Kundenterminen. Schliesslich dreht sich bei FELFEL alles um gutes Essen.
  • Gültige Arbeitsbewilligung für die Schweiz oder Schweizer Pass.


WAS WIR BIETEN

  • Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...
  • Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine
  • 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Pro Jahr gewähren wir zwei ganze Wochen "Work from anywhere" und sorgen damit für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag
  • Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV
  • Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten
  • Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings
